description: This file contains utility functions for networking operations related to a board management system, including authentication, fetching boards, finding URL properties, creating cards, and generating GUIDs with custom base32 encoding.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with specified method, host, resource, body, and token, returning the parsed JSON response or throwing an error if present.

methods.name: logIn
methods.description: Authenticates a user with username and password, returning a token.

methods.name: getBoards
methods.description: Fetches boards from the server, filtering out templates.

methods.name: findUrlPropertyId
methods.description: Finds the ID of the URL property within a board's subtree.

methods.name: createCard
methods.description: Creates a new card on a specified board with given title and URL.

methods.name: createGuid
methods.description: Generates a GUID using random bytes and base32 encoding.

methods.name: randomArray
methods.description: Generates a Uint8Array of specified size with cryptographically secure random values.

methods.name: base32encode
methods.description: Encodes data into a base32 string using a custom alphabet, with optional padding.
